packageRules.description: The kernel, pnpm, slicc-cdp and the wasm, wasi and wasix command packages (the base set's and the optional catalog's) go to seven only after the homescoop coordinator certifies them, often as a set, so Renovate opens their PRs but never merges them. slicc-agent and slicc-spectrum are held too: agent releases can carry a newer kernel client, both change the UI and follow the spectrum ordering rule, and their automerges kept conflicting with bios PRs that change the neighbouring pins.
